scenarios.avi_challenge: bay between two 4 m girders closed at both ends by diaphragms; clear width 3.8 m, roofed by the deck slab
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: no sky view, no GNSS, propeller downwash recirculates off three surfaces, and the walls are inside the minimum focus range of a long-baseline stereo rig
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: short-baseline stereo or structured light, wall-referenced odometry, reduced thrust profile
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_01_CONFINED_GIRDER_BAY

scenarios.avi_challenge: mid-channel under-deck volume, 24 m of concrete overhead and open water below
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: GNSS fully occluded by the deck, no ground texture for downward optical flow -- the water moves
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: visual-inertial odometry referenced upward to the soffit, not downward
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_02_GNSS_DENIED_UNDERDECK

scenarios.avi_challenge: pier waterline band, the highest-value defect zone on a river pier
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: specular sun glint off moving water saturates the sensor and produces phantom depth returns; the surface is also wet and dark
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: polarising filter, oblique approach away from the specular lobe, exposure bracketing
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_03_WATERLINE_REFLECTION_BAND

scenarios.avi_challenge: column face at 27 m above ground on the tallest pier in the zone
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: channelled wind across the valley plus vortex shedding off the column; station-keeping error directly becomes image blur
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: windward standoff increase, gust-tolerant position hold, shorter exposure with higher gain
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_04_TALL_PIER_WIND_EXPOSURE

scenarios.avi_challenge: bearing seat: a 0.7 m recess enclosed by the pier cap below, the girder above and the diaphragm behind
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: reachable from a single narrow cone of viewpoints; a UAV that cannot achieve that cone returns no data at all rather than bad data
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: articulated or gimbal-forward sensor, approach along the cap axis
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_05_OCCLUDED_BEARING_SEAT

scenarios.avi_challenge: hairline cracking, 0.05-0.20 mm, on a web face that is in permanent shadow under the deck
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: the defect signal is a few grey levels wide against aggregate mottle of similar amplitude -- it is a contrast problem, not a resolution problem
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: on-board illumination at grazing incidence, HDR capture, and detection thresholds tuned per illumination condition
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_06_LOW_CONTRAST_SHADOW_CRACK

scenarios.avi_challenge: underside of an expansion joint: chronic leakage path, so the surrounding concrete is the most reliably deteriorated on the deck
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: wet and stained surface changes the reflectance model; the joint gap itself reads as an infinite-depth void to a depth sensor
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: treat gaps as no-data rather than as geometry, and classify staining separately from cracking
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_07_EXPANSION_JOINT_UNDERSIDE

scenarios.avi_challenge: flat deck soffit directly overhead, 0.9 m above the aircraft
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: the inspection surface is where a UAV has no sensor and where downwash reflects straight back; ground effect against a ceiling is destabilising in the opposite sense to ground effect below
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: upward-facing sensor, ceiling-effect-aware controller, fixed standoff hold
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_08_OVERHEAD_DECK_SOFFIT

scenarios.avi_challenge: outer parapet face alongside live traffic on a crest
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: vehicle-induced gusts arrive at traffic speed and are not predictable from ambient wind; a lateral excursion of 1.2 m puts the aircraft over the carriageway
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: work from the outboard side only, hard lateral geofence at the parapet line, abort on gust threshold
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_09_PARAPET_EDGE_TRAFFIC_EXPOSURE

scenarios.avi_challenge: outer parapet and deck edge in full sun, reachable from any direction
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: none in particular -- this is the control case, and a detector that cannot find defects HERE has no chance anywhere else
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: baseline condition; use it to calibrate before attempting anything harder
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B01_OPEN_DAYLIGHT_INSPECTION

scenarios.avi_challenge: general under-deck volume beneath the slab
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: illumination is bounce only; exposure differs by four stops from the sky visible at the deck edge
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: onboard illumination, HDR capture, exposure lock
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B02_UNDERBRIDGE_INSPECTION

scenarios.avi_challenge: between two girders with the slab overhead, 3.8 m clear
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: no sky, no GNSS, downwash recirculates off three surfaces, and the walls sit inside a long-baseline stereo minimum range
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: short-baseline stereo or structured light, wall-referenced odometry, reduced thrust
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B03_DEEP_UNDERSIDE_INSPECTION

scenarios.avi_challenge: land pier column, circumnavigation required
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: the column is a curved surface, so a single standoff pass leaves the flanks at grazing incidence
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: orbit the column rather than translating past it
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B04_PIER_INSPECTION

scenarios.avi_challenge: waterline band on a river pier -- the highest-value defect zone on the whole structure
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: sun glint off moving water saturates the sensor and produces phantom depth returns; a ditching is unrecoverable
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: polarising filter, approach off the specular lobe, exposure bracketing, hard abort altitude
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B05_RIVER_PIER_INSPECTION

scenarios.avi_challenge: bearing seat: a 0.7 m recess enclosed by the pier cap below, the girder above and the diaphragm behind
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: reachable from a single narrow cone of viewpoints; miss the cone and you return NO data rather than bad data
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: gimbal-forward or articulated sensor, approach along the cap axis
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B06_STRONG_OCCLUSION

scenarios.avi_challenge: translating the length of a bay between girder webs with under a metre either side
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: lateral clearance is below the depth camera's minimum range, so the walls are invisible exactly when they matter
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: side-facing short-range sensing, or fly the bay centreline on wall-referenced odometry
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B07_NARROW_STRUCTURAL_CORRIDOR

scenarios.avi_challenge: the same surfaces worked under the NIGHT scenario
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: ambient contributes nothing; every photon is the aircraft's own, so illumination falls off as 1/r^2 and exposure couples to standoff
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: constant-standoff flight so illumination is constant, calibrated light, longer dwell
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B08_LOW_LIGHT_INSPECTION

scenarios.avi_challenge: the shadow line of the parapet crossing the surface under inspection
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: a single frame cannot hold both sides of the shadow edge; a crack crossing it appears twice with different contrast
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: HDR bracket, or work the surface at a time of day when the shadow line is elsewhere
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B09_PARTIAL_SHADOW

scenarios.avi_challenge: open water beneath, structure above
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: downward optical flow fails over moving water; depth returns from the surface are unreliable and intermittent
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: reference odometry UPWARD to the soffit, treat downward depth as no-data
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B10_REFLECTIVE_WATER_ENVIRONMENT

scenarios.avi_challenge: screening a whole span from 45 m standoff to decide where to go close
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: at 45 m the ground sample distance is 28 mm, so anything under severity 3 is below the noise floor; the honest output is a coarse triage map, not a detection
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: use it to PRIORITISE, never to clear a surface
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B11_LONG_RANGE_DETECTION

scenarios.avi_challenge: 0.5-1.0 m standoff, where a hairline crack finally spans enough pixels to be detected
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: depth of field is shallow, downwash is close enough to disturb loose material, and station-keeping error is a large fraction of the standoff
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: mechanical or visual standoff reference, short exposure, accept a small field of view
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B12_CLOSE_RANGE_INSPECTION

scenarios.avi_challenge: column face high on the tallest pier in the zone (37 m)
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: CONCEPTUAL ONLY -- no wind field is simulated. The marker records where channelled wind and vortex shedding would make station-keeping error into image blur
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: increase windward standoff, gust-tolerant hold, shorter exposure at higher gain
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B13_HIGH_WIND_CONCEPTUAL

scenarios.avi_challenge: mid-channel under-deck, 24 m of concrete overhead and open water below
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: CONCEPTUAL ONLY -- no GNSS physics is simulated; the avi_gps_quality field is metadata a navigation stack consumes. Geometrically, the sky really is fully occluded here and there really is no ground texture below
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: visual-inertial odometry referenced upward to the soffit; do not expect a position fix
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B14_GPS_DENIED_CONCEPTUAL

scenarios.avi_challenge: the SECTOR_C / SECTOR_D boundary, where two aircraft working adjacent sectors come closest
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: each aircraft is a moving obstacle the other's planner did not place, and both are inside the other's inspection standoff
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: the 20 m separation buffer volume, plus a protocol that gives one aircraft the boundary at a time
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B15_MULTI_UAV_SHARED_WORKSPACE

scenarios.avi_challenge: a suspended maintenance platform hanging inside the under-deck working volume
scenarios.avi_sensing_problem: the obstacle is NOT on the digital twin. A planner working from the twin alone flies into it; only live depth sensing prevents that
scenarios.avi_suggested_mitigation: enable AVI_DYNAMIC_OBSTACLES, plan from the twin, and require the aircraft to detect and re-route
scenarios.name: SCENARIO_B16_DYNAMIC_OBSTACLE
